statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-1965: libcurl can reuse an existing connection that was authenticated with HTTP Negotiate (SPNEGO) for a later Negotiate request to the same server made with different credentials, so the second request is sent over a connection authenticated as the first user (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-1965.html). It affects curl 7.10.6 to 8.18.0 and was fixed in curl 8.19.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/34fa034d9a390c4bd65e2d05262755ec8646ac12 and its follow-up https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/f1a39f221d57354990e3eeeddc3404aede2aff70. Negotiate authentication is only built into libcurl when it is compiled with GSS-API (SPNEGO) support. The DHI curl packages for Alpine 3.23 are builds of curl 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0 (in both the main and the security repository), 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1. In the libcurl package of every one of these builds, on x86_64 and aarch64, libcurl links no GSS-API library and contains none of the Negotiate, SPNEGO and GSS-API strings that a Negotiate-capable libcurl carries; the same search finds all three in the Debian 13 libcurl builds, which link libgssapi_krb5. The debug information in curl-dbg for every one of these builds has no Curl_input_negotiate function, while Curl_input_digest is present as a control. These builds are made without Negotiate support, so the vulnerable code is not present.

statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-1965: libcurl can reuse an existing connection that was authenticated with HTTP Negotiate (SPNEGO) for a later Negotiate request to the same server made with different credentials, so the second request is sent over a connection authenticated as the first user (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-1965.html). It affects curl 7.10.6 to 8.18.0 and was fixed in curl 8.19.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/34fa034d9a390c4bd65e2d05262755ec8646ac12 and its follow-up https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/f1a39f221d57354990e3eeeddc3404aede2aff70. Debian backported both commits to trixie in 8.14.1-2+deb13u4 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-1965). The DHI curl packages for Debian 13 are rebuilds of Debian's trixie curl 8.14.1-2; the DHI Debian repository publishes three of them (the rebuild of 8.14.1-2+deb13u5 and two rebuilds of 8.14.1-2+deb13u7) for amd64 and arm64. Every published build is based on 8.14.1-2+deb13u5 or later, and the Debian changelog each one ships records the fix under 8.14.1-2+deb13u4, so the lowest published build, the rebuild of 8.14.1-2+deb13u5, is the fixed version used here. Earlier rebuilds of 8.14.1-2+deb13u3 and before, which this request also matches, are no longer published; they are based on Debian releases from before the fix and sort below the fixed version.
